description.zh:
AXG中的G组ID，即GID。

- 登录号码隐私保护控制台，在[号码池管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面筛选出**AXG隐私号**，单击**G号码组管理**即可查看所有G号码组的GID。
- 如果G号码组是通过接口[CreateAxgGroup](~~110250~~)创建的，则接口的返回参数**GroupID**就是此处的请求参数**GroupID**。
description.en:
The G group ID (GID).

- Log on to the Phone Number Privacy Protection console. On the [Number Pool Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page, filter for number pools of the **AXG Privacy Number** type and click **G Number Group Management** to view the IDs of all G groups.

- If you created the G group by calling the [CreateAxgGroup](~~110250~~) API, use the returned **GroupID** as the value for this **GroupId** parameter.

description.zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，[号码池管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取**号码池Key**。
description.en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the **key of the number pool** on the [Number Pool Management](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Phone Number Privacy Protection console.

descriptions.zh:
- G号码组删除后不可恢复，请谨慎操作。

- 在调用此接口前，建议您先确认需要删除的G号码组及该号码组归属的号码池。

- 不支持删除存在绑定关系的G号码组，删除G号码组前，建议您先解除AXG隐私号与该号码组的绑定关系。可登录控制台，在[号码管理](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list)页面，筛选**AXG隐私号**，单击**详情**>**解绑**进行操作，或者调用[UnbindSubscription](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-unbindsubscription)接口解除号码的绑定关系。

- 删除G号码组时，如果G号码组内存在号码，也会一并删除。

### QPS 限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为 5000 次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Deleted G groups cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.

- Before calling this operation, verify the G group to be deleted and the Number Pool it belongs to.

- You cannot delete a G group that has active bindings. Before you delete the group, you must unbind the associated AXG privacy number. To do this, log on to the Phone Number Privacy Protection [Console](https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list), go to the **Number Management** page, filter by **AXG privacy number**, and click **Details** > Unbind. Alternatively, you can call the [UnbindSubscription](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-unbindsubscription) API to unbind the number.

- When you delete a G group, all phone numbers in the group are also deleted.

### QPS limit

The single-user QPS limit for this API is 5,000 requests per second. API calls that exceed this limit are subject to throttling. Plan your API calls accordingly to prevent disruptions to your business.
